summary.name: Video Background Remover
summary.one_liner: A web-based AI tool that removes backgrounds from uploaded video clips and exports them with transparent or custom backgrounds.
use_cases: Removing backgrounds from talking-head or interview videos
Cleaning up product demo videos for e-commerce
Creating green-screen-style effects without a green screen
Replacing indoor or outdoor backgrounds in presentations or webinars
Making transparent WebM clips for overlays
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI tool that detects subjects in a video and removes the background, with the option to export transparent output as WebM or MP4 with a blur or solid color background. It accepts MP4, AVI, MOV, MKV and WMV uploads, with stated limits of 120 seconds on desktop and 30 seconds on mobile. One section says processing (segmentation, frame processing, audio and export) runs locally in the browser tab and that files are not uploaded, while another section says uploaded files are deleted from the server within 24 hours, so the page is inconsistent about where processing happens. It also states that heavier cloud models give better results for products, animals, and complex objects or fine hair detail.
notable: Transparent output in WebM, since MP4/H.264 lacks an alpha channel
Processing described as running in the browser tab with no upload, account or per-video API fee
Plan tiers listed (Starter, Professional, Business) with video removal quotas and API access on Business
caveats: Paid plans (Starter, Professional, Business) are listed with per-plan removal quotas; exact prices are not shown in the text
Maximum clip length is 120 seconds on desktop and 30 seconds on mobile
Page says the browser tab must stay open during processing, and the privacy statements about local versus server processing conflict
